summary: Wipro Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a tender-offer share buyback. The company repurchased 600 million equity shares (face value INR 2 each) at INR 250 per share on a proportionate basis from shareholders as of the June 5, 2026 record date. The buyback was conducted under SEBI regulations and announced in Indian newspapers and stock exchanges. This is a closed buyback program, not a new offer. As a completed event, there is no risk-arb angle; the focus is on the reduction in outstanding shares and potential EPS accretion.
